licenses.text:
Public domain.

The World English Bible's copyright page (https://ebible.org/engwebp/copyright.htm) says:
"The World English Bible is in the Public Domain. That means that it is not copyrighted."
Its only condition concerns the name: if the text is changed, the result is not to be called the
World English Bible. "World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org.

eBible.org publishes it from the United States. The page states no restriction on AI or machine
learning use.

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-web-07317969, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training.
